description: Make one focused change to a saved iter0 design: pass its designId and the change as prompt. iter0 loads the current page itself and saves the edit as the design's current page; the card offers Undo. For a page the person pasted into the chat (no designId), pass that page exactly as currentHtml; the revised HTML comes back and no saved design changes. Costs 0.5 credits. The first call returns a price quote and changes nothing; the edit runs only when the person confirms that quote, in the card or by saying yes in chat, and iter0_confirm_paid_action redeems it.

inputSchema.description: MCP body limit: 2,250,000 UTF-8 bytes. Serialized argument limit: 2,100,000 UTF-8 bytes. String maxLength values are character ceilings; UTF-8 byte limits also apply.

approvalId.description: Compatibility receipt for a quote already confirmed in iter0. New quotes are redeemed with iter0_confirm_paid_action.

currentHtml.description: A page the person pasted into the chat, used when there is no designId. A saved design is edited by designId; iter0 loads its page. At most 2,000,000 UTF-8 bytes.

designId.description: The owned design to edit, from iter0_get_design or iter0_list_my_designs. iter0 loads its current page and saves the edit as its current page.

prompt.description: The focused edit instruction. At most 32,000 UTF-8 bytes.

referenceUrl.description: Optional visual reference. At most 2,048 UTF-8 bytes.

sectionId.description: The section ID from iter0_get_design or iter0_get_site_status for the same designId; replaces selectedAreas.

name: iter0_edit_site

quoteId.description: The reference of the price quote the person accepted.

updatedAt.description: The time the save gave the design; the card shows it in its Projects list.

title: Edit a site
